preconditions.description: The input `s` must be a string. Non-string inputs are invalid.

postconditions.expression: not any(c.isdigit() for c in s) or return_value == -1
postconditions.description: If the string `s` contains no digits, return `-1`.

postconditions.expression: digits := [int(c) for c in s if c.isdigit()] and product := 1 and all(0 <= d <= 9 for d in digits) and all(d != 0 or product != 0 for d in digits) and (product := eval('*'.join(map(str, digits))))
postconditions.description: Compute the product of all digits in `s` (ignoring non-digit characters). If no digits exist, return `-1`.

postconditions.expression: product_str := str(product) and len_digits := len(product_str) and (return_value == -1 if len_digits == 0 else (return_value == int(product_str[len_digits // 2]) if len_digits % 2 == 1 else (return_value == int(product_str[len_digits // 2 - 1 : len_digits // 2 + 1]) if product_str[len_digits // 2 - 1] != '0' else return_value == int(product_str[len_digits // 2]))))
postconditions.description: If the product is zero, return `0`. Otherwise, return the middle digit(s) of the product as an integer. For even-length products, return the two middle digits as a single integer (ignoring leading zero if present).
